IIT JAM Online Form 2027 – Full Details

Indian Institute of Technology IIT Kharagpur has invited application for the IIT Joint Admission Test for Masters 2027 (JAM 2027). Online Registration Process for IIT JAM Application Form 2026 has started from 05 September 2026 and candidates can apply till 12 October 2026. Candidates can check complete details for IIT JAM Application Form 2026 which has given on this page.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 05 September 2026
  • Last Date : 12 October 2026
  • Last Date For Fee Payment : 12 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 14 February 2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam
  • Result : 18 March 2027

Application Fee

  • For Single Paper
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST, PH, Female : Rs. 1000/-
  • For Double Paper
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 2700/-
  • SC, ST, PH, Female : Rs. 1350/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification

IIT JAM Online Form 2027 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
